Hero_Desc_Butter:
A werebeast with a perpetually cheerful and bright personality. She always tries to make friends.
No one has seen Butter angry before...
Maybe we'll be able to see it one day though.
Album_Like_Butter: Other's playing with her. Making new friends.
Album_Butter1: A werebeast with a bright smile always on her face, as if she's a ray of sunshine. I'm still getting used to that personality, but once she become friends with you, she follows you around, agreeing to everything.
Album_Butter2: Whether accidentally flipping the plate during a meal, getting tangled and tripping over denizens because they're so close together, or even getting hit in the head with a ball while playing... Butter is always forgiving. Almost to a fault...
Album_Butter3: There is only one thing Butter can't tolerate: 'Having a falling out.' She dislikes the idea of having a falling out so much that she tries to mend any relationships to prevent any rifts, even if there's a good reason.
Album_Butter4: Because of Butter's unique personality, I worry she might be at a disadvantage when hanging out with her other friends. Fortunately, and surprisingly, the other werebeasts do not treat her poorly.
Album_Butter5: I also heard a strange rumor about Butter. Although Butter is usually kind and cheerful, when she reaches her limit, a switch goes off, and she becomes explosively angry to the point where she becomes unstoppable.
Album_Butter6: When I asked her the truth about this rumor, Butter seemed unaware she had such a trait. Even though she gets incredibly intense when angered, she acts as if she doesn't care what others have to say. Does it really matter, I guess?
Album_Butter7: According to Diana, she was actually the one who started that rumor. Apparently, there used to be friends who'd often take advantage of Butter. But after Diana spread that rumor, they stopped bullying Butter.
